## Problem / Use Case
A clear and concise description of the problem your feature proposal solves. E.g., *"I'm always frustrated when..."*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the API or component behaving.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here. (DO NOT post real Firebase credentials or private keys).
